This program will provide the operating divisions within BUD the basic information required to consider total energy as an alternate energy supply.
Our interest in total energy plants, in addition to economics, encompasses an interest in possibly reducing fuel consumption and air pollution. Specifically, at Jersey City, the total energy plant fuel requirement is a little more than half of the total fuel that would be required on site for providing heating, air conditioning and domestic hot water (500,000 gallons/year) and for providing electrical energy (another 630,000 gallons/year). The conventional approaches would also have higher thermal and air pollution.
